narrative.details:
It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.

From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.

The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.
narrative.objectives: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.
